scientific_scope: reuse the completed atomic-decoration Monte Carlo ensemble and isolate only the reciprocal-grid/measurement-adapter difference between the previous exact-q run and the source paper's no-Lanczos SCATTY calculation

source.disclosed_grid_statement: SCATTY calculated hk0.5 with no Lanczos resampling; maximum in-plane resolution was 1/24 r.l.u. for the 24x24 supercell.
source.code_availability: The actual custom Monte Carlo code is available only on request; no public code artifact was found in the article, SI, Zenodo record, or discoverable author repositories.

frozen_parent.reuse_rule: sampled_spins are immutable; no Monte Carlo move, seed, schedule, or n_d estimate is rerun or changed

experimental_preprocessing.normalization: match each replica/candidate prediction maximum to the experimental maximum on the compared finite-pixel grid

native_grid.boundary_note: both +/-0.5 reduced-coordinate boundaries are retained; their lattice coefficients alias but their absolute-q motif factors need not

measurement_adapters.selection_rule: report every frozen adapter; do not select an adapter post hoc from agreement with 0.144(12)
measurement_adapters.rationale: the paper discloses the simulation grid and no-Lanczos setting but does not disclose how the 0.05-r.l.u. experimental reconstruction was placed on the 1/24-r.l.u. SCATTY grid for pointwise chi-square

operators.primary_map_backend: exact 24x24 inverse-FFT lattice coefficients times exact absolute-q atomic motif difference and the analytic two-layer l=0.5 contraction

ranking.primary: mean of four independently maximum-normalized full-native-grid chi-square curves using bilinear experimental-to-native adaptation
ranking.uncertainty: two sample standard deviations across four replica chi-square values

claim_boundary.reason: This audit isolates the disclosed SCATTY native grid using the same frozen spin ensemble, but the authors' n_d estimator and the exact experimental-to-SCATTY grid adapter remain unpublished.
claim_boundary.promotion_gate: The native-grid best must be stable across preregistered adapters and Monte Carlo estimators, or the authors' actual code/grid adapter must be obtained.
